report:
(A) Lung, right middle and lower lobes, bilobectomy
(B) Pleura, parietal, biopsy

(A) The specimen consists of a right middle and lower lobes bilobectomy specimen (520 g, 210 x 150 x 70 mm). The visceral pleura is involved by tumour grossly. Sectioning reveals a firm, grey-white, necrotic tumour measuring 52 mm in greatest dimension (52 x 45 x 40 mm), subpleural, 25 mm from the bronchial margin. Separate tumour nodule(s) are present in the other lobe (a 12 mm nodule in the middle lobe with the same morphology). The remaining lung parenchyma is spongy and unremarkable.

(A1-6) Lower lobe tumour with pleura.
(A7-8) Middle lobe nodule.
(A9) Bronchial margin, shave.
(A10) Vascular margin, shave.
(A11-12) Lymph nodes, station 11R.
(A13) Parietal pleural nodule (part B).

(A) Lung, right middle and lower lobes, bilobectomy
Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Bilobectomy
- Laterality: Right
- Lobe(s): Middle lobe, Lower lobe
- Tumour site: Peripheral
- Tumour size: 52 mm in greatest dimension (52 x 45 x 40 mm)
- Invasive size (lepidic component excluded): 52 mm (no lepidic component)
- Separate tumour nodule(s): Different ipsilateral lobe (a 12 mm nodule in the
  middle lobe with the same morphology)
- Pleural surface (gross): Involved grossly

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Invasive adenocarcinoma, solid predominant (solid 60 %,
  acinar 40 %)
- Histologic grade: Grade 3 (IASLC 2020; solid predominant, 60 % high-grade
  patterns)
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show an invasive adenocarcinoma, solid predominant (solid 60 %,
  acinar 40 %). The tumour invades the visceral pleura (PL2, confirmed on
  elastic stain). Immunohistochemistry: TTF-1 positive, napsin A positive.
- Spread through air spaces (STAS): Not identified
- Visceral pleura invasion: PL2, extends on visceral pleura surface (elastic
  stain performed)
- Lymphatic and / or vascular invasion: Present
- Tumour extension: Not applicable
- Treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy

Margins
- Bronchial margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma (closest distance 25 mm)
- Vascular margin: Uninvolved by carcinoma
- Parenchymal margin: Not applicable

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 2 examined; 0 involved
  - Stations (involved/examined): 11R: 0/2
  - Number examined: 2
  - Number involved: 0

Distant metastasis
- Distant metastasis: Pleural nodules (parietal pleural nodules, part B)

Pathological stage (AJCC 9th edition)
- pTNM: pT4 pN0 pM1a
  - Stage group: IVA

Additional findings
- None

(A) LUNG, right middle and lower lobes, bilobectomy
- INVASIVE ADENOCARCINOMA, solid predominant, 52 mm, visceral pleura invaded
  (PL2); lymphovascular invasion present; separate tumour nodule(s) in the other
  ipsilateral lobe; bronchial margin clear; see synoptic report
- 0 of 2 regional lymph nodes involved
- distant metastasis: pleural nodules
- pT4 pN0 pM1a (AJCC 9th edition), stage IVA

(B) PLEURA, parietal, biopsy - METASTATIC ADENOCARCINOMA
